info.name: SKY-2 · API cases
info.description:
Built from test-cases/api/API-OP-001..005.md (SKY-2, rule 06 — Business Rules § 1.4, TSD-4 §2.1). One folder per case; each folder registers its own operator, pilot, aircraft and flight request. Variables are prefixed per case (op001_ ... op005_).
Sources: 06 — Business Rules § 1.4, § 4, § 6; 03 — API Contract § Flight requests, § Error semantics, § The 422 body; 02 — Request Lifecycle; openapi.yaml.
Run the local copy with a logged-out Postman CLI; pass baseUrl and operatorPassword with --env-var.
